column2: (7) Nothing in this section shall relieve a taxpayer from
the requirement to file the tax return to which the advance
assessment served under this section relates.
(8) A tax return filed by a taxpayer for a tax period after
an advance assessment has been served on the taxpayer for
the period is not a self-assessment return.
